liquidity.notes: Revolut does not disclose in-app crypto liquidity, internal order flow, or per-trade capacity. Exchange limits are per-account and plan-dependent.

volume_30d_usd.notes: Revolut does not publish in-app crypto trading volume.

observed_spread_bps.notes: Published terms: USD↔USDC (and USDT on the UK schedule) convert 1:1 with no spread and no exchange fee — the $1k stablecoin onramp leg is free before withdrawal. Non-stablecoin trades pay the plan/volume-tiered fee (Standard 1.49% at $1k) plus an execution-time rate markup that is NOT publicly observable — attestation target.

assumptions.plan: any (stablecoin exemption applies to all plans)
assumptions.exchange_fee: 0 — fiat↔stablecoin exchanges exempt from % and minimum fees
assumptions.rate: USDC/USD converts 1:1, no spread (depeg and abuse carve-outs apply)
assumptions.fair_usage: Standard: crypto exchanges count toward the £1,000/mo exchange allowance; beyond it a 1% fair-usage fee applies. $1k fits a fresh allowance.
assumptions.network_fee: variable, quoted in-app at withdrawal, passed through — excluded here (attestation target)
assumptions.usdt_note: USDT/USD 1:1 also published (UK schedule); EEA USDT availability is restricted post-MiCA — USDC used as the anchor

assumptions.deposit_fee: 0 — "We do not charge any fees for deposits"
assumptions.rate: USDC/USD converts 1:1, no spread (depeg and abuse carve-outs apply)
assumptions.fair_usage: same fair-usage allowance caveat as the onramp leg (Standard/Plus)
assumptions.offboarding_note: getting USD out of Revolut to a bank is a fiat transfer priced by the account plan, not the crypto product

cost_1k.notes: Derived from the published fee schedule (venue-reported, not independently observed). The tiered exchange-fee structure is replaced by flat fees on 2026-08-10 (Standard/Plus 1.49%, Premium/Metal 0.99%) — stablecoin exemption unchanged.
